claim_assertions.q4_gaap_and_adjusted_same_direction: Q4FY2025 GAAP and adjusted net income both grew relative to Q4FY2024.
claim_assertions.litigation_majority_annual_gap: Litigation accounts for more than half the FY2025 adjusted-minus-GAAP net-income gap.
claim_assertions.same_quarter_price_effect_identified: The supplied same-quarter volume growth identifies the exact pricing contribution to service revenue growth.

definitions.gross_to_net: FY2025, Q4FY2025 and 9MFY2025. Gross sums four positive revenue categories, incentives keep their negative source sign. First nine months is annual less Q4.
definitions.net_income_reconciliation: Use the net-income column of each reconciliation, already after tax. Missing categories are not separately observed adjustments.
definitions.income_growth_bridge: Windows FY and Q4FY compare FY2025 with FY2024. Gap change is current adjusted-minus-GAAP gap less prior gap.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
